subject: Novaplex compliance kickoff & evidence coordination
messages:
From: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@novaplex.io>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Novaplex compliance kickoff & questionnaire

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this — Novaplex is starting the vendor intake for SOC 2 and a SIG/CAIQ review as part of our procurement approval. We'd like to schedule a 45-minute kickoff to walk through the questionnaire and evidence handoff. High-level asks from our side: confirm what artifacts you can provide (logging samples, retention policies, encryption controls), your SLAs for evidence delivery, and who the internal owners are for each artifact.

Proposed times (all ET):
- Tue May 11, 10:00–10:45
- Wed May 12, 09:00–09:45
- Thu May 13, 14:00–14:45

I've attached a partially completed SIG spreadsheet so you can see the sections where we'll need clarifications.

Attachments: Novaplex_SIG_partial.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Tom Bennett
Security Program Manager
Novaplex
security@novaplex.io
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@novaplex.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 18:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Novaplex compliance kickoff & questionnaire

Tom — thanks for the note and the SIG file. We're happy to run the kickoff and map owners. 45 minutes is perfect. We can do Tue May 11 at 10:00 ET — I just penciled that in.

Pre-call: please confirm whether you want a walk-through of our CAIQ answers live or prefer we share a completed CAIQ export ahead of time. Either works; live walk-through is helpful for clarifying intent.

What we typically provide as sample artifacts before or during the call:
- 7 days of anonymized log samples and sampling instructions
- RBAC/role diagram and a short note on onboarding/offboarding workflow
- System architecture diagram showing network segregation and encryption-in-flight
- A short spreadsheet mapping SIG/Caiq questions to internal owners

Owners on our side (cc'd):
- Marissa Cole — account lead / evidence coordinator
- David Kim — security engineer (logs, telemetry, encryption)
- Ben Carter — controls and SOC liaison (policy text, attestations)

I attached a brief pre-call checklist and will drop the evidence upload instructions to Drive prior to the meeting. If you want to review any specific sections ahead of the call, flag them and we'll prioritize.

Attachments: redwood-precall-checklist-0504.pdf (checklist)

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Bennett <tom.bennett@novaplex.io>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 09:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Novaplex compliance kickoff & questionnaire

Thanks — confirmed for Tue May 11, 10:00 ET. We'd prefer you share the CAIQ export ahead of time if possible; that will speed the review on our side.

Two small asks for prep:
1) Do you have a copy of your encryption key lifecycle policy (even a redacted excerpt)?
2) For the log samples, can you provide an example that includes masked customer IDs and shows request/response timing?

I've also attached two items from our side: the partial SIG and a short intake checklist that lists our internal reviewers.

Attachments: Novaplex_SIG_partial.xlsx (updated), novaplex-intake-checklist.pdf

Tom

Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 11:07:00 -0400

Tom / Novaplex team — attaching the agenda and a short pre-call artifact pack. Quick notes:
- We'll export our CAIQ answers and share a PDF by EOD Mon May 10. That will include references to the artifacts below.
- Log sample is anonymized and contains macro timestamps and latency buckets; David will walk through masking rules during the call.

Planned agenda (45m):
1) Intros + objectives (5m) — Soojin, Marissa
2) CAIQ/SIG mapping overview (10m) — Ben
3) Log/telemetry sample walkthrough (10m) — David
4) Artifact upload process + access (5m) — Marissa
5) Q&A and open items (15m)

Pre-call artifacts (shared to Drive):
- redwood-ca i q-export-20270510.pdf (CAIQ export)
- redwood-log-sample-2027-05.tar.gz (anonymized log samples)
- rbac-diagram-v1.pdf (role mapping)
- evidence-upload-instructions.md

Action owners (internal):
- Ben: prepare CAIQ answer highlights and controls mapping
- David: prepare log masking notes and sample walkthrough
- Marissa: create Drive folder and send invite to Novaplex security@novaplex.io

I'll send calendar invite with the meet link momentarily. Looking forward to it.

Attachments: redwood-ca i q-export-20270510.pdf (pdf), redwood-log-sample-2027-05.tar.gz (tar.gz), rbac-diagram-v1.pdf (pdf)

Soojin
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Quick internal note before the call — copy into thread after the meeting:

Owner checklist: 
- Ben: pull the three highest-risk CAIQ questions and be ready with examples (items 7.1, 9.2, 13.4).
- David: confirm we can produce the anonymized logs (masking script ready) and bring the RBAC diagram.
- Marissa: confirm Drive sharing and include Novaplex reviewers; ensure evidence-upload-instructions.md is the single source of truth.

Open dependency: Tom asked for encryption key lifecycle excerpt. David — can you pull the redacted KMS policy snippet by Monday morning? If we can't include it in the Drive, we can present it live and provide a redacted copy post-call.

Thanks — see you on Tue.

Marissa
